title: Four moons
content: So I just woke up (5a est), and was startled to remember in my dream, being outside with others, looking up. There were four moons, one was full, one half, one (toenail) sliver, and another the same size, but facing away. It was like the whole world stopped and saw it, gaping in silence. I took out my phone to snap a photo, and woke up with a quickness. Anybody else “see” the four moons in their dream last night? I just had to ask, it seemed of some importance.
